title: Kestra OSS: attackers can run commands on it
verdictReason: Attacks are confirmed. The vulnerability is 128 days old, so current versions are being attacked. The severity score is critical (10.0).

category.label: Developer tools
category.why: It holds source code and the keys used to build and ship software.
category.doThis: Patch it. If it faced the internet, change the keys and passwords stored in it.

summary: Kestra OSS contains an OS command injection vulnerability that could allow an unauthenticated remote attacker to create and execute arbitrary workflows without credentials.
fix: CISA's instruction: apply the vendor's fix, or stop using the product if no fix exists. The deadline CISA set for US federal agencies, Sep 5, 2026, has passed. It is a US government deadline; use it as a guide.

evidence.title: Kestra OSS OS Command Injection Vulnerability
2 public GitHub repositories claim a proof of concept for CVE-2026-49869
CISA Vulnrichment marks CVE-2026-49869 as actively exploited
